headline: CPO transitioning to climate & biodiversity impact 🌍 | Born at 337 ppm
summary: After 15 years helping build and scale a global tech company — from a 5-person startup to a 700+ people scale-up — I’m now dedicating my experience and energy to addressing the environmental crisis.  My next chapter is driven by a clear intention:  → 🌍 to contribute directly to climate action, environmental resilience, and the preservation and regeneration of biodiversity.  I’m open to Product leadership roles, cross-functional positions, or missions beyond Product — as long as they are hands-on and anchored in a genuine, uncompromising impact mission.  🚀 WHAT I BRING Over the years, I’ve had the privilege to:   - Define product vision & strategy for a global, widely adopted technology   - Bridge engineering & product, building strong alignment and collaboration   - Scale Product organisation from early-stage to multi-team structures   - Build empowered teams that take ownership and deliver meaningful outcomes  I believe in:   - Collective intelligence as a driver of innovation   - Mission clarity as a foundational compass   - The power of open-source ecosystems to accelerate progress in a collaborative way, benefiting to everyone   - Leadership grounded in trust, transparency and long-term thinking  🌱 WHERE I WANT TO CONTRIBUTE I’m particularly interested in organisations working on    - climate mitigation & climate adaptation,    - biodiversity regeneration,    - regenerative and circular models,    - decarbonisation,    - or environmental data and technology.  If your mission aligns with these areas and you believe my experience could help move things forward, I'd love to connect.  I’m here to listen, learn, and contribute.
